title: Taiwan's Focus on AI and Economic Growth
description: Taiwan is making significant strides in the field of artificial intelligence, with increased investment in AI startups and compute infrastructure.

sources.title: Taiwan's Wistron says AI server demand remains strong, quarterly profit up 128%
Taiwan's FSC and NDC Launch TiBOOST Program with NT$5 Million Prize to Attract Global AI Startups
Taiwan steps up investment in AI startups, compute infrastructure

sections.heading: Economic Growth
paragraphs: Taiwan's economic growth is being bolstered by its focus on artificial intelligence. According to Reuters, Taiwan's Wistron has reported a 128% increase in quarterly profit, attributing this growth to the strong demand for AI servers.

sections.heading: AI Investment
paragraphs: digitimes reports that Taiwan is stepping up its investment in AI startups and compute infrastructure, indicating a strategic move to capitalize on the growing global demand for AI technology.

sections.heading: Global AI Startups Attraction
paragraphs: In an effort to attract global AI startups, Taiwan's FSC and NDC have launched the TiBOOST Program, which offers a prize of NT$5 Million, as reported by BigGo Finance.
